decision: Finite negative for selected ordinary title-write/list/update contract. No proved ordinary new counterexample; no whole-store/permission/lock/runtime correctness conclusion.
exclusions: Old manual-title vs automatic-title/double-source observations are existing evidence, not a new finding.
No invented requirement that Desktop optional CAS must be exposed or all list snapshots be globally transactional.
Title override removal via empty string differs from session archive/deletion. Full session deletion, account/owner semantics and underlying lock/native efficacy are outside this review.
